Physicians are professionals at the healing arts, with deft and steady hands suited to medical procedures from dressing wounds to ameliorating even the worst of maladies.

SKILLS

Doctorate

You may perform Medical Procedures, which follow the same rules as Rituals but use a Medical Check — (DEX + INS) or (INS + INS) — and are costed in zenit or Inventory Points at the Game Master's discretion: Minor (100 zenit / 3 IP, Difficulty Level 7) through Extreme (800 zenit / 6 IP, Difficulty Level 16), addressing injuries, conditions and ailments from a dislocation through to organ transplants and magical disease.

Drug Synthesis · SL max 3

When you create a potion, you may combine it with up to (SL) Pharmaceuticals of your choice; the resulting compound carries all component effects and all component Inventory Point costs, plus any listed synergy.

Emergency Aid · SL max 5

When an item or spell you use restores Hit Points and/or Mind Points to a target that is in Crisis, that target recovers +(SL × 5) additional Hit Points and/or Mind Points.

Organized Pharmacy · SL max 3

Carry +(SL × 2) Inventory Points, ring-fenced for use with Pharmaceuticals and Drug Synthesis items. If this Skill is taken at character creation, those Inventory Points arrive stocked. The satchel and its current stock are tied to the Guise. This Skill grants capacity, not supply — refills cost 10 zenit per Inventory Point.

Pharmaceuticals · SL max 5

Each level stocks two catalogue entries. Create-and-use via the Inventory action, as consumables.

THE PHARMACEUTICAL CATALOGUE

Liniment (Steroid, physical)4Attacks deal +Minor for the scene · synergy: next attack +Heavy
Coca Elixir (Steroid, magical)4Spells +Minor for the scene · synergy: next spell +Heavy
Vinum Ferri (Steroid, endurance)4Printed erratum — the printed text duplicates the magical steroid. Named, and unusable until the effect exists.
Quinine Wine (Steroid, acuity)4+Minor max MP for the scene. A derived-stat effect: it rides the worn Guise and expires at the scene's end
Carbolic Preparation (Mutagen, defense)4Resistance to one chosen type, scene
Steadying Drops (Mutagen, offense)3Reroll HR once per turn, scene
Antitoxin (Vaccine)3Immunity to one chosen status effect, scene · synergy: statuses land but Attribute dice stay unchanged
Numbing Agent3Next damage reduced by Minor (minimum 1) · synergy: Heavy instead

Antitoxin does not remove a status — it prevents one.

These names are interim. Naming is not settled; see `PHYSICIAN-naming-worksheet.md`.
